en: Color postcard showing a panoramic cityscape of Arad, Romania, with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings along a broad boulevard and a distinctive onion‑domed corner turret in the foreground. The reverse bears a Romanian airmail stamp with an airplane, circular ARAD postmarks dated in the early 1960s, printed headings, and handwritten Romanian message and address.
